name: Does fiber cement siding come with a warranty?

mainEntity.name: Does fiber cement siding come with a warranty?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, fiber cement siding products typically come with a manufacturer's warranty, often ranging from 30 to 50 years on the material itself. Additionally, City Dweller, LLC provides a warranty on the installation workmanship. It's important to understand the specifics of both warranties, including coverage details and any conditions that may apply, to ensure long-term peace of mind regarding your investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Fiber cement siding usually includes a manufacturer's material warranty (30-50 years) and an installation workmanship warranty from City Dweller, LLC.
